spec_match.rationale: Exercises the spec's colour-space conversion pipeline in both directions: per-backing-store storage (one fillStyle across all four PredefinedColorSpace canvases) and per-request conversion (getImageData with ImageDataSettings colorSpace/pixelFormat on one unchanged canvas), which is exactly the 'as defined by CSS' contract the ChromeStatus summary names.

interactive.rationale: Preset and free-text CSS color inputs re-run every measurement live; both tables are rebuilt from real getContext/fillRect/getImageData calls on each change.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises one fillStyle read back through every space with the shipped srgb/display-p3 pipeline working today and the linear rows joining in 155 — matches the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers out-of-gamut clipping (P3 red reads [255,0,0] as srgb), unparseable custom colors (explicit message, tables keep last valid state), unavailable spaces rendered with their real TypeError text, the accepted-but-normalised guard, and 8-bit quantisation vs the rgba-float16 view.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5122501071994880, the spec conversion section, the ImageData/ImageDataSettings interface, and CSS Color 4 predefined-to-predefined conversion.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's getimagedata-converts-between-predefined-spaces assertion encodes this page's core measurable (sRGB red → display-p3 ≈ [234,51,35]) and passes today; the linear ImageData assertions cover the rows that activate in 155.

runtime_evidence.rationale: chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this environment; verified per the routine toolset with headless Chromium 141 via Bash + CDP. Unflagged: 2 of 4 stores available, srgb stores [255,0,0,255] / display-p3 stores [234,51,35,255] for #ff0000, 4 of 6 readbacks served with float16 returning Float16Array [1,0,0,1]; linear rows show the exact TypeError. Flagged: 3 of 4 stores and 5 of 6 readbacks as srgb-linear activates. Invalid custom color and lab() color paths driven; desktop + emulated 360×740 DPR3 screenshots; zero page exceptions.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts on every render with color, store availability and served-readback counts, including an unparseable-color failure record and an init failure branch.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; ok/blocked verdicts are text plus colour meeting AA; tables scroll in .scroller containers; controls are 44px minimum; the swatch canvas shows the actual color under test, which is the demo subject.

accessibility.rationale: Semantic tables with captions and row/column headers carry the numeric story; the swatch canvas has role=img with an aria-label naming the color; summaries are aria-live=polite; select and text input are natively labelled; status cells are words, not colour alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360×740 DPR3 and 1280 desktop verified: no page-level horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 360, tables scroll in their own containers), controls stack, custom input appears/hides correctly on both classes.

openQuestions.title: Demonstrate dark-end posterisation once a linear canvas can be created on stable
openQuestions.detail: The page states that linear stores quantise badly in 8 bits and shows the float16 view, but the most vivid version — a dark linear-space ramp visibly banding in unorm8 vs smooth in float16 on a real srgb-linear canvas — needs the 155 enum values. When available, add a ramp stage comparing getImageData default vs rgba-float16 on an srgb-linear canvas.

openQuestions.title: Round-trip putImageData with linear-tagged ImageData
openQuestions.detail: Readback is covered; the write direction (putImageData of an ImageData tagged srgb-linear onto canvases of each space, per the spec's conversion-on-put rules) is the remaining pipeline edge. A small additive stage could measure a put-then-get round trip.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible canvas demo with text alternatives and live region readouts
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer real data tables with caption/scope for numeric matrices and keep status readable without colour.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both matrices are semantic tables; every status cell is a word; summaries announce via aria-live; the only canvas is a labelled swatch whose exact values appear in the adjacent table.

guidanceConsulted.query: wide gamut and HDR canvas color management
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide tabular content scrolls in its own overflow container; long error strings need overflow-wrap so they cannot widen the page on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .scroller wrappers, mono cells with overflow-wrap:anywhere; verified scrollWidth 360 on the emulated mobile viewport.

summary: The inspection concept: real numbers for the conversion pipeline. Works meaningfully today (srgb vs display-p3 storage, getImageData conversion, float16 precision) and extends row-by-row as the linear spaces arrive — each row reporting exactly what the browser did, verified in both unflagged and flagged states on Chromium 141.
